body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SCH-B630'' a red wine colored T-DMB phone with ultra-edition 12.9 design concept. It features 3M camera with auto focus, electronic dictionary, mp3 playback, and Bluetooth.
